items.headline: Davante Adams goes off — Rams roll the Giants 28-6
items.body: Matthew Stafford threw four touchdown passes and Davante Adams caught two of them on his way to 195 yards on the night. The Giants had a scary moment too, with rookie QB Jaxson Dart banged up.
items.say: Did you catch Davante Adams last night? 195 yards — dude turned back the clock on Monday night.

items.headline: Haaland finally completes the set
items.body: In a wild 5-3 win over Sunderland, Erling Haaland tapped in late to score against Sunderland for the first time — meaning he's now found the net against all 25 Premier League clubs he's ever faced.
items.say: Haaland has now scored against literally every Premier League team he's played. The guy's a cheat code.

items.headline: Down to the wire — baseball's final week is here
items.body: Six teams are locked in, but the wild-card scramble is chaos: the Cubs, Phillies and Padres are basically tied in the NL, and the AL's last spots could come down to Sunday. First pitch of October is Sept. 29.
items.say: The MLB playoff race is an absolute mess right now — like five teams fighting for two spots. Love this time of year.

items.headline: VALORANT's world championship tips off Thursday
items.body: Champions 2026 lands in Shanghai starting Sept. 24 — 16 teams, a $2.25M prize pool, and the usual over-the-top anthem (this year featuring Bring Me The Horizon's Oli Sykes) to kick it all off.
items.say: The VALORANT world championship starts this week in Shanghai — and the hype anthem honestly slaps.

items.headline: Brad Pitt and a very good dog vs. the wilderness
items.body: 'Heart of the Beast' opens Friday — a David Ayer survival thriller with Brad Pitt as an ex-Special Forces soldier stranded in the Alaskan wild with his retired combat dog after a plane crash.
items.say: New Brad Pitt survival movie this weekend — him and his combat dog stranded in Alaska. I'm in.

items.headline: Survivor hits 51 — and it's the 'Open Era'
items.body: Survivor returns Wednesday with a two-hour premiere and a fun twist: every advantage, idol and trick from 50 seasons is now fair game, plus some brand-new wrinkles. Jeff Probst is loving it.
items.say: Survivor's back Wednesday and this season every twist from the whole show's history is in play. Chaos.

items.headline: McConaughey and Harrelson… actual brothers?
items.body: Apple TV's comedy 'Brothers' drops its first two episodes Wednesday. Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson play versions of themselves who discover they might literally be siblings — a running real-life rumor the pals lean all the way into.
items.say: There's a new McConaughey–Woody Harrelson show where they might actually be brothers. Feels like it writes itself.

items.headline: Queen Latifah takes a big red chair
items.body: 'The Voice' kicked off Season 30 this week with a shake-up: Queen Latifah and country star Riley Green join Kelly Clarkson and Adam Levine in the coaches' chairs. Carson Daly's now on his 30th straight season hosting.
items.say: Queen Latifah's a coach on The Voice now — that's a fun get. New season just started.

items.headline: The Smiths' Johnny Marr is back with new music
items.body: Guitar legend Johnny Marr announced a new album, 'The Age of Everything' (out Oct. 2), and shared the shimmering opener 'Spin.' If you grew up on that jangly Smiths sound, this is right in the pocket.
items.say: Johnny Marr from The Smiths has a new album coming — the first single's got that classic guitar shimmer.
